proof_hardening: Complete rational algorithm supplement retained verbatim; no change to reduction or factor.
accepted_claims: For rational accretive L and 1<=k<=n with rank L<=k+1, a deterministic polynomial-bit 2^O(k) approximation. At rank k+1 and h=rank Sym(L)>0 the factor is 2h k^k/k!, bounded by (4e)^k.

Exact positive decomposition into h rational full-rank Gram objectives. Rank k uses one Gram objective; rank<k and rank k+1 with H=0 have zero optimum. Singular symmetric parts, zero minors, mixed odd k, and invertible even-dimensional skew reductions are included.

The complete fixed-rational-step D-optimal-design proof: tau=1/(4k^2), determinant increase at least 1/(16k^2) in log per performed step, polynomial iteration count and denominator growth, exact leverage stopping certificate, and coefficient-interpolation conditional-expectation rounding.

For each fixed radius rho, explicit rational strictly accretive and strictly nonsymmetric Hadamard families have strict rho-local maxima with competitor gap at least (4k/(17rho^2))^k for unbounded powers of two k. This does not refute globally informed initialization or other algorithms.

At codimension two, the explicit strict-accretivity compound form has quadratic value -6 on a nondecomposable bivector. This blocks that PSD extension, not general approximation. Exact single-Gram support and symmetric-part-only obstructions retain their limited scope.

Complete rational marginal-initialization clarification and Rouche annular-sector repair, including coefficient inequality, endpoint-zero cases, and polynomial graph-cut bound. External sector-stability and local-to-global spectral theorems remain scoped imports.
limitations: General rank>=k+2 remains unresolved, apart from separate trivial regimes such as k=1. No hardness threshold is proved.
The Hadamard local-search barrier was already present in the symmetric setting; the attributed strictly nonsymmetric variant carries no novelty claim.

Finite exact checks support the written arguments and do not certify universal theorems. No optimizer, candidate code, or source-author code was executed in the independent audit; no mathematical computation was rerun for this edition.
Published baseline k^O(k) arithmetic-runtime statements are not attributed a rational-bit or numerical-stability guarantee. The retained supplement supplies its own polynomial-bit algorithm proof.

Later-source checks are bounded. Gram/strongly-Rayleigh coreset results and conditioning-dependent log-determinant bounds do not establish the requested unrestricted determinant ratio in the inspected statements.

Source texts, source PDFs, screenshots, executable code, raw generated test inputs and raw enumeration outputs are omitted. Analytical matrices and constructions essential to the written proofs are retained.
